newsitem.title: CANADA: TrizecHahn to develop CN Tower attraction.
newsitem.headline: TrizecHahn to develop CN Tower attraction.

text.p: TrizecHahn Corp said on Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to lease and operate Toronto's CN Tower for an initial 35 years, with two 15-year renewal options, and develop adjoining lands.
It said it will also purchase certain related assets in a project to create a retail and entertainment-oriented complex next to SkyDome and the newly expanded Metro Toronto Convention Centre.

Under the letter of intent with Canada Lands Co Ltd, TrizecHahn will lease the CN Tower and acquire 151 Front Street, a 250,000-square foot mixed-use building, and SkyWalk, an enclosed pedestrian walkway linking Union Station to the CN Tower.
The deal is subject to final negotiations and is expected to be completed within 30 days.
